shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && rg --files app'

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next -maxdepth 4 -iname '*proxy*' -o -iname '*middleware*' | head -80 && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && cat app/page.tsx && cat app/layout.tsx && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- middleware.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && git diff --check && cat middleware.ts && cat .gitignore'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && test -f middleware.ts && test ! -d .next && test ! -f next-env.d.ts && test "$(git diff -- tsconfig.json | wc -c)" -eq 0'
